decisions.why: examples are lacrimal/ocuplastic surgical instruments and consumables (punctum dilator and plug inserter, bicanaliculus intubation set sizer, Ritleng probe, PVP perforated plugs) - surgical consumables and packs for ophthalmic procedures, not lenses, capital equipment or glaucoma drug delivery

examples (light connectors, chandelier silicone ring, disposable light probes, RetiJet) are single-use vitreoretinal surgical consumables used during procedures, not IOLs, capital imaging equipment or glaucoma devices
implant, crescent, paracentesis and trapezoid knives are ophthalmic surgical blades - surgical consumables used in cataract/anterior segment procedures

Lou's rule 25/08/2026: the division's own evidence names products from more than one category, so it goes in all of them rather than picking one — RIBOCROSS/RIBOFAST corneal cross-linking solutions (surgical consumables & packs) sit alongside the CF X-LINKER device (capital equipment)
own category is literally 'Contact Lenses' and both examples (daily/monthly contact lenses) are consumable ophthalmic optical products

sole example, Kitaro DryLab & WetLab Kit, is a cataract-surgery wet-lab training/simulation kit for surgeons, not a patient-implantable product — matches the existing training simulation-equipment type, same class as the bariatric empathy training suits
